description: I’m a 10th grade high school student. I’m skilled at critical thinking when it comes to connecting concepts and I’m able to make them  beneficial and useful. I’m interested in  making a monitoring  health software design to help make healthcare more beneficial to astronauts on space missions. Teammates in this project are required to be innovative and capable of connecting ideas and concepts, as well as having the ability to connect them through creative software designs, program, etc.
